The evidence explicitly defines the Jacobian matrix $Df$ with entries $Df_{ij}$ (partial derivative of channel $i$ with respect to spatial dimension $j$) and defines the structure tensor $G$ as $G = (Df)^T Df$. Thus, the mathematical formula in the claim is directly supported by the matrix definition provided in the evidence.
